title: a build that still has a success key validates: the key is removed and, like any unknown key, accepted and ignored
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, pre-release fixes (success is removed from builds)
intent: `success` is not part of the build schema any more, and the build validator accepts and ignores unknown keys (docs/build-schema.md). A file that keeps the key, even with the shape that used to be an error (an entry with no check name and a placeholder naming a field the build does not require), is ok: `build validate withsuccess` prints its ok line and exits 0.

stdout.equals:
ok withsuccess repo jitso/builds/withsuccess.yaml
checked 1 builds: 1 ok, 0 invalid
